# Silicon Peaks

> The open-source name for the technology ecosystem centered in Kathmandu, Nepal. Dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0 Universal.

Silicon Peaks is a record, not a campaign. The argument is at https://siliconpeaks.com/. The directory of companies, universities, investors, and organizations is at https://siliconpeaks.com/directory.

## Key figures (August 2026)

- **IT exports**: about $1 billion in 2025, more than double the $515 million in the 2022 IIDS study (NAS-IT estimate; Kathmandu Post, 25 Feb 2026: https://kathmandupost.com/national/2026/02/25/nepal-s-it-exports-near-1-billion-can-the-momentum-be-sustained).
- **Venture and growth capital**: more than $200 million disclosed into companies on this record (compiled from public rounds; not a single filing).
- **Remittances**: $12.64 billion in FY 2024/25, on the order of 28% of GDP (Nepal Rastra Bank annual data: https://www.nrb.org.np/contents/uploads/2025/08/Current-Macroeconomic-and-Financial-Situation-English-Based-on-Annual-data-of-2024.25.pdf).
- **Diaspora**: 4.5 million+ people of Nepali origin; NRNA councils in 90 countries; about 800,000 permanent expatriates in developed economies.
- **Directory**: 94+ operating companies plus 15 NYSE/NASDAQ names previously listed on this site, 98 universities, 47 investors, 19 organizations. Search at /directory.

## Four company stories (public-primary sources)

- **Daraz**: Founded 2012 by Rocket Internet; Alibaba acquired 100% on 8 May 2018. Nepal was one of five markets. https://techcrunch.com/2018/05/08/alibaba-buys-rocket-internets-daraz/
- **Fusemachines**: Nasdaq:FUSE from 23 Oct 2025; majority of staff in Nepal. https://ir.fusemachines.com/news-and-events/press-release/fusemachines-begins-trading-on-nasdaq-marking-the-start-of-a-new-chapter
- **CloudFactory**: $7.3M Series B (24 May 2017); $65M growth equity led by FTV Capital (20 Nov 2019). https://ftvcapital.com/2019/cloudfactory-secures-65-million-in-growth-equity-funding-led-by-ftv-capital/
- **SecurityPal**: $21M Series A (Craft Ventures / a16z, Sep 2022); SOCC Kathmandu inaugurated 21 Feb 2023 with US Ambassador Dean R. Thompson; 210+ staff (Nepali Times, 24 Aug 2026). https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/securitypal-inaugurates-247-security-operations-command-center-with-united-states-ambassador-301751436.html
